description: Don't answer this comment: it leaves comments_to_answer and Inbox for good and nothing is sent. Pass account_id and the comment_id from comments_to_answer. Only the ids are kept, never the comment's words. Dismissing a comment again does no harm. For an answer already drafted, use comment_reply_skip.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

network.description: The account's network; checked against the account when given

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: comment_dismiss
title: Dismiss a comment
